page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.2xlarge is an x86_64 server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the CPU and memory subsystems generally fall into the lower tiers. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, as well as Geekbench scores, place the processor in the bottom 25%. However, the Passmark CPU score and extended instructions test reach average levels. Memory performance shows a contrast: while read-only bandwidth is weak, large-block write bandwidth achieves average performance. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as single-threaded gzip compression, perform poorly, landing in the bottom 10%.

Given the bundled 959 GB SSD storage and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance offers a balanced resource density for storage-centric workloads. It is well-suited for database operations, local caching, and general-purpose applications that require fast local disk access but have moderate CPU demands. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance, though the older processor architecture limits its suitability for compute-intensive tasks or large-scale LLM inference.
